text:
𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟰 𝗧𝟮𝟬 𝗪𝗢𝗥𝗟𝗗 𝗖𝗨𝗣 𝗪𝗜𝗡𝗡𝗘𝗥𝗦 🏆

India beat South Africa by 7 runs in Barbados on 29 June 2024.
Kohli 76, India 176/7, South Africa 169/8. An 11-year wait for an ICC trophy ended. 🇮🇳

#Cricket #T20WorldCup
